title: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 4.1 Hindu-Arabic Positional System: Evaluate an exponential expression.
summary: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, 4.1 Hindu-Arabic Positional System: Evaluate an exponential expression.
body: OpenStax Contemporary Mathematics, section "4.1 Hindu-Arabic Positional System", prints these objectives: "Evaluate an exponential expression." "Convert a Hindu-Arabic numeral to expanded form." "Convert a number in expanded form to a Hindu-Arabic numeral.". This card reports that page.
